data.name: Still Air
data.description: The student of perfection can spend 1 ki point to cast calm emotions. His caster level is equal to his class level, and the save DC is %1. He can spend 3 ki points as an immediate action to use this ability on himself when he is affected by an emotion effect, a confusion effect, or a fear effect.|StudentOfPerfectionKiDC
